messages.author: 4300b948ac2443de
messages.subject: Feature request
parts:
I'd like to throw in a request for a new feature: A missing values tab

Some of the algorithms seem to have a problem handling missing values.
There are several methods for dealing with missing values that would
fit nicely in the tab-style of Rattle.

That's an excellent suggestion. I have been wanting to get on top of a
unified way of dealing with missing values, and a tab to support this
might be worth it.

If you had specific examples (and R code snippets) of what you would do
then it would make it a lot easier to start the implementation of it.

Many thanks,
Graham
